items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: we made those recordings with Clyde Bernhardt in '72

ctx.x: You know. (Unintelligible) hear what Charlie would do. And Charlie wouldn't take it. I asked Charlie about it here about three years ago, said, no, Happy (unintelligible), we made those recordings with Clyde Bernhardt in '72. He says, no. I says, well, Charlie, why? He said, I think on account of him and Johnny was from the same --

Well, you know, I've heard a story with him, oh, two years before those records with Bernhardt. and he said he didn't like recording, and he wasn't going to record any more. And then when I heard them, he didn't sound too bad. But I -- you know, I think the lip muscles are -- you really got to work at it a little bit to --
